summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue of an UnboundLocalError when max_post_process_passes is set to 0, but it may not be the most robust solution.

issues.description: The patch initializes 'substitutions' outside the loop, which might not be the best approach. It could lead to confusion about the intended logic flow and might not cover all edge cases where 'substitutions' should be reset.

While the automated tests pass, there are no additional tests specifically added to verify the behavior when max_post_process_passes is set to 0. More comprehensive tests should be included to ensure the fix is robust.
